# Copy Claims Check

> **One rule:** every statement that advertises a benefit or makes a comparison must have real evidence or be cut. This skill checks copy against announcements that were actually opened and read. It is **not legal advice**, and it is not approval from the Thai Food and Drug Administration (อย., FDA) or the Office of the Consumer Protection Board (สคบ., OCPB). For risky or high-value work, have someone responsible for legal matters, or the company's licence applicant, look at it before posting.

Check the text on images, captions, scripts, and post pages before release. This is not a complete list of banned wording. Passing here does not mean the copy is legal.

## Use when / Do not use when

- Use when: a post, banner, video, or sales script contains a benefit claim, a superlative, a comparison with a competitor, a review, or promotion conditions
- Do not use when: writing a product listing on Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop → `sales-copy` (plugin `e-commerce`, if installed) · product images for a marketplace → `marketplace-product-images` · checking how an image looks → `design-review` · personal data requirements → `pdpa-workflow` (plugin `e-commerce`)

## 1 · Scope actually read (2026-11-10)

| Product type | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Food and dietary supplements | Read the full announcement | ประกาศ อย. เรื่อง หลักเกณฑ์การโฆษณาอาหาร พ.ศ. 2564 (FDA announcement on food advertising criteria, B.E. 2564; Royal Gazette volume 138, special part 73 ง, dated 30 March 2021 (B.E. 2564)) https://exfood.fda.moph.go.th/law/data/announ_fda/64_Advertising.PDF · FDA fact sheet "คำโฆษณาเกินจริงที่ห้ามใช้กับผลิตภัณฑ์อาหาร" (exaggerated claims banned for food products), dated 23 November 2022 (B.E. 2565) https://dis.fda.moph.go.th/detail-infoGraphic?id=2077 |
| General advertising copy for any product | Read 2 pages from สคบ. | https://www.ocpb.go.th/news_view.php?nid=9759 (page dated 1 April 2019 (B.E. 2562)) · https://www.ocpb.go.th/news_view.php?nid=16458 (18 June 2025 (B.E. 2568)) |
| Drugs, cosmetics, medical devices | The FDA announcements for this category have not been read | (รอยืนยัน) (awaiting confirmation) Do not apply the list below to these products. Open fda.moph.go.th for that category first |
| Finance, investment, loans | Not read | (รอยืนยัน) The regulator of each business, such as the Bank of Thailand or the Securities and Exchange Commission (ก.ล.ต.) |
| Sponsored reviews · image and music copyright · promotion condition text | No official source read | (รอยืนยัน) |

The 2021 (B.E. 2564) FDA announcement was read from the Royal Gazette file. Whether a later amendment exists has not been checked. Check the FDA's "food advertising law" page again before citing it in work sent to a customer. Re-check every 6 months (next 2027-05-10).

## 2 · Checklist of 6 items

The Thai rules in the right-hand column come only from the sources in section 1.

| # | What to check | Rule actually read (food and supplements) | The rest |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Superlatives or guarantees | FDA 2021 (B.E. 2564) announcement, list no. 1 item 1, says these words are not allowed: ศักดิ์สิทธิ์ (sacred) มหัศจรรย์ (amazing) ปาฏิหาริย์ (miracle) วิเศษ (wonderful) · ที่สุด (the most) ดีที่สุด (the best) สูงสุด (the highest) สุดยอด (the ultimate) · ที่หนึ่ง (number one) หนึ่งเดียว (the only one) · เด็ดขาด (decisive) หายขาด (cured for good) หมดกังวล (no more worry) · ไม่มีผลข้างเคียง (no side effects) ไร้ผลข้างเคียง (side-effect free) · อย. รับรอง (FDA approved) ปลอดภัย (safe) · เห็นผลเร็ว (fast results) · Other products: the สคบ. page bans false or exaggerated statements | The same words for non-food products (รอยืนยัน) |
| 2 | Health or beauty benefit claims | Item 4 and list 1 items 2.1–2.5: treating, curing, or preventing disease · changing the structure or function of the body (for example detox, boosting immunity) · sexual performance · skin and beauty (for example whitening skin, reducing wrinkles) · weight loss (including Before/After photos, tape-measure photos, and the words "ผอม" (slim) "หุ่นเป๊ะ" (perfect figure)). An image that gives the same meaning is also not allowed · Item 4(8): citing research or statistics that the FDA has not assessed | Drugs, cosmetics (รอยืนยัน) · finance (รอยืนยัน) |
| 3 | Comparing with or putting down competitors | Item 3(7): do not compare with or disparage other people's products (food) | Other products (รอยืนยัน) |
| 4 | Reviews and endorsers | Item 3(6): do not let medical and public health personnel, or people who present themselves as such, recommend, endorse, or praise the food (food) | How a sponsored review must be disclosed (รอยืนยัน), no official source was read |
| 5 | Copyright of images, music, fonts | No official source was opened | (รอยืนยัน) Use your own images, or images you hold a right to use under a contract that you keep |
| 6 | Promotion conditions and numbers | Item 3(1)–(2): do not make people think the product has an ingredient it does not have, or has more of it than implied · The สคบ. page (nid=9759) bans statements that mislead about the substance of the product or service | The format of minimum condition text (รอยืนยัน) |

2 more notes that were actually read:

- If an AI-generated image misleads consumers about the substance of the product, สคบ. says it may count as unfair advertising (page nid=16458 dated 18 June 2025 (B.E. 2568) · the guidance announcement is still being prepared, per that page). Check that the product image matches the real product.
- Food advertising that shows benefits needs FDA permission before it is published. The permit is valid for at most 5 years, the permit number must appear in the material, and the text must match what was permitted in full (items 6 and 7(3)). A dietary supplement must show "ไม่มีผลในการป้องกันหรือรักษาโรค" (has no effect in preventing or curing disease) and other text per item 9(10). On still media, the warning must be at least 1/25 of the height of the advertising area (item 8(2.2)). Always check the full text against the announcement itself. This file summarizes only some items.

## 3 · Steps

1. Ask or find out which type the product is (food · supplement · drug · cosmetic · other) and who is the licence applicant for the advertising. For a non-food type, stop at step 3 and write (รอยืนยัน) in the result. Do not guess from the food rules.
2. Pull out every statement the reader sees or hears: text on images, captions, hashtags, spoken words in the clip, the product name, before and after photos.
3. Go through the 6 items in section 2 for each statement, and fill in the **result table** below.
4. For a food benefit claim, the options are to cut it, to replace it with a provable fact (an ingredient on the label, size, price), or to send it for advertising permission. Do not reword it indirectly while keeping the same meaning, because the announcement counts text that "implies or shows" a meaning, images included.
5. Send the result to the decision maker (the brand owner or whoever handles the company's legal matters), with all the (รอยืนยัน) items. Never say "it passed the law".

### ผลตรวจ (result table template)

The columns are: the text · where it is · checklist item · level · how to fix.

| ข้อความ | อยู่ที่ไหน | ข้อในเช็กลิสต์ | ระดับ | แก้อย่างไร |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| "ลดน้ำหนักได้เร็ว" | ภาพโพสต์ 1 บรรทัดที่ 2 | 2 | ต้องแก้ | ตัดออก · ถ้าอยากพูดเรื่องนี้ ถามผู้ขออนุญาตก่อน (ข้อ 4(6) และข้อ 6) |
| "ดีที่สุดในประเทศ" | แคปชัน | 1 | ต้องแก้ | ตัดออก หรือใส่ข้อเท็จจริง เช่น "คั่วสดทุกวัน" ถ้าทำจริงทุกวัน |
| "ผิวขาวใสใน 7 วัน" | คลิป 0:12 | 2 | ต้องแก้ | ตัดออก |
| ภาพสินค้าไม่ตรงของจริง | ภาพหลัก | 6 | ต้องแก้ | ใช้ภาพของจริง |
| ข้อความโปรโมชัน | ล่างภาพ | 6 | ดู | ตรวจวันที่และตัวเลขกับการ์ดแคมเปญ (`campaign-set`) |

Levels: `ต้องแก้` (must fix) = the text matches an item the announcement does not allow · `ดู` (take a look) = the decision maker should look at it · `(รอยืนยัน)` = no official source has been read. These levels belong to this skill and are not the wording of the law.

## Check before sending

1. Every statement the reader sees or hears is in the result table, not only the easy-to-spot ones.
2. Every rule cited has an item or list number and a link that comes from section 1. No rule is written from memory.
3. Non-food product types, sponsored reviews, copyright, and finance are written as (รอยืนยัน) and not guessed.
4. The result says plainly that it is not legal advice and that the owner of the work decides.

Related: to find or verify the source behind a claim, use `research-with-sources` (plugin `superuser`).
